programme.title: Let The Right One In
programme.desc: Oskar, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Eli, a beautiful but peculiar girl.

programme.title: Lasso
programme.desc: An Active Senior Tour group outing turns deadly when the crazed, bloodthirsty cowboys from a local rodeo attraction start abducting and killing people!

programme.title: Meek's Cutoff
programme.desc: Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.

programme.title: Big Ass Spider!
programme.desc: The unlikely heroic duo of a blue-collar exterminator and Latino security guard must save the day when a military major loses control of a giant spider rampaging through the city of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Monsters in the Closet
programme.desc: A horror's author's stories come to life when read out loud.

programme.title: Uncaged
programme.desc: After finding a gruesomely slaughtered family just outside Amsterdam, the police calls veterinarian Lizzy for help. She finds herself leading the city-wide hunt for a monstrous lion terrorizing the Dutch capital in this grisly adventure.

programme.title: Shark Girl
programme.desc: When a beautiful young influencer survives a mysterious shark attack, she becomes a monstrous apex predator, hunting and feeding in sunny Venice beach, California.

programme.title: Bad Milo
programme.desc: A man learns that his unusual stomach pains are being caused by a demon living in his intestines.

programme.title: The Golem
programme.desc: A mystical woman must save her village from invaders, but the entity she conjures to protect them is a far greater evil.

programme.title: Wraith
programme.desc: After living in an old mansion for almost 10 years a family suddenly discovers a ghost-like presence trying to communicate with them.

programme.title: Book of Monsters
programme.desc: Sophie's 18th birthday becomes a bloodbath when monsters descend upon her house and start to devour the party guests.

programme.title: Wind Walkers
programme.desc: With one of their own missing, a group of friends travel to the remote Florida everglades where they discover that an ancient, malevolent curse is tracking them.

programme.title: The Mimic
programme.desc: A classic Korean ghost story gets a horrifying new spin. As the mother of a missing child takes in a lost girl she finds in the woods, she soon begins to wonder if she is even human.

programme.title: Mermaid Down
programme.desc: A mermaid is ripped from the Pacific, her tail is chopped off and she's thrown into a mental home where no one believes she is a mermaid.

programme.title: The Cursed
programme.desc: A supernatural thriller set in a cozy Tennessee town where Sheriff Jimmy Muldoon and younger brother, Deputy Lloyd Muldoon, have a firm grasp of law and order until a stranger, Denny White, comes to town and horrible things begin to happen.

programme.title: SPLINTER
programme.desc: Trapped in a gas station by a parasite, a couple and an escaped convict must find a way to survive.

programme.title: SPLINTER
programme.desc: Trapped in a gas station by a parasite, a couple and an escaped convict must find a way to survive.

programme.title: Mermaid Down
programme.desc: A mermaid is ripped from the Pacific, her tail is chopped off and she's thrown into a mental home where no one believes she is a mermaid.

programme.title: Marrowbone
programme.desc: A ghostly presence and a lawyer come between four young siblings. They must stand together or be torn apart.

programme.title: The Woman in the Fifth
programme.desc: A college lecturer flees to Paris after a scandal costs him his job. In the City of Light, he meets a widow who might be involved in a series of murders.

programme.title: Violet & Daisy
programme.desc: Two teenage assassins accept what they think will be a quick-and-easy job, until an unexpected target throws them off their plan.

programme.title: Vanishing on 7th Street
programme.desc: A blackout causes a city's population to vanish. A handful of survivors realize they escape the darkness.

programme.title: Robot Overlords
programme.desc: Earth has been conquered by robots from a distant galaxy. Survivors are confined to their houses and must wear electronic implants, risking incineration by robot sentries if they venture outside.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmakers Moorhead and Benson return with this mind-bending thriller that follows two brothers who receive a cryptic video message inspiring them to revisit the UFO death cult they escaped a decade earlier.

programme.title: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
programme.desc: Two sisters live in isolation with their deranged uncle following the deaths of the rest of their family. When a cousin comes to visit, family secrets and scandals unravel. Based on the beloved Shirley Jackson novel.

programme.title: Reaper
programme.desc: Criminals and a beautiful but cunning hitchhiker battle a supernatural force known as the Reaper.

programme.title: A Dark Way Out
programme.desc: A selfish petty thief ready for an easy score at a vacant house unexpectedly finds himself in the role of hero when he walks into a home invasion.

programme.title: Pistolera
programme.desc: When ruthless drug lord RAFAELLO murders the family of a little girl named ANGEL in a gangland hit in SPAIN, he makes one fatal mistake: Letting her live. Thus Rafaello sets in motion a bloody chain of events in this gritty street tale of revenge... and its cost.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
Works by Mendelssohn & Hensel
programme.desc: A 2020 performance of Mendelssohn and Hensel at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Germany.

programme.title: Piano Duets -- Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o
programme.desc: Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff and Nikolai Kapustin.

programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - The Nutcracker
programme.desc: The Ballet du Capitole performs "The Nutcracker," with choreography by Kader Belarbi.

programme.title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna from Vienna's Café Sperl; the ensemble consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic.

programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Nikolay Lugansky presents works by Rachmaninoff as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov.

programme.title: Fantasymphony - A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with a concert program; under the baton of Christian Schumann, the bands team up and perform from "Lord of the Rings," "The Witcher," "League of Legends" and more.

programme.title: Divas and Diamonds
programme.desc: A performance filled with unforgettable voices and expressiveness.

programme.title: Gaming X Symphony: Legends & Quests in Concert
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, with Nordic singer Eivør as special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Chopin: Piano Concertos No. 1 & No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21; soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin.

programme.title: Mozart, Symphony No. 41, K. 551
programme.desc: Jeffrey Tate conducts the English Chamber Orchestra in a performance of Mozart's Jupiter Symphony No. 41; the symphony is the last of a set of three that Mozart composed in rapid succession during the summer of 1788.

programme.title: Faure's Requiem
programme.desc: Winchester Cathedral Orchestra and the English Chamber Choir perform the piece; host John Gielgud.

programme.title: The LSO performs Dvořák and Tchaikovsky
Gaming X Symphony: Legends & Quests in Concert
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, with Nordic singer Eivør as special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: All your favorite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the concert hall, together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.

programme.title: Bach: Goldberg Variations BWV 988
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's "Goldberg Variations BWV 988" at the Leipzig Bach Festival.

programme.title: Schumann - Violin Concerto & Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
Gershwin's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: A firework display with music from Hollywood films.

programme.title: Walton: Viola Concerto & Brahms: Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Brahms's Symphony No. Four; Antoine Tamestit continues his Artist Portrait.

programme.title: A Tango Night: Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: The Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colón under Daniel Barenboim performs live at an Argentinean music festival.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programme.desc: A musical journey through the sounds of Oscar winners, from classics like "Casablanca" and "Citizen Kane" to monumental cinematic works like "The Godfather"; blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven's final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler's "Symphony No. 2" in C minor, "Resurrection."

programme.desc: Nick Jackie Chan es un inmigrante chino, que ha entrado ilegalmente en Japón en busca de su novia y de un futuro mejor. Al descubrir, por azar, que su novia es ahora la esposa de un jefe Yakuza, decide entrar en el mundo del crimen organizado convirtiéndose en poco tiempo, con la ayuda del jefe Yakuza a quién casualmente salva la vida, en un auténtico líder, aprendiendo como sobrevivir en un mundo donde la corrupción, el asesinato y las luchas internas entre las distintas mafias, ponen constantemente a prueba su liderazgo y sus principios.

programme.desc: Cuando un joven príncipe y su fiel ayudante se enteran del hermoso sueño eterno y maldito de una bella princesa, emprenden un viaje para rescatarla. Deben batallar contra una malvada reina y legiones de monstruos no muertos antes de que ella quede libre.

programme.title: Impacto Solar
programme.desc: Cuando los desechos solares caen contra la Tierra provocando una devastación generalizada, la radiación solar resultante provoca mutaciones genéticas en todos los que entran en contacto. A medida que la radiactividad se propaga rápidamente, y con los gobiernos y militares de todo el mundo al borde del colapso, un grupo de amigos se une para huir del caos, desesperados y con la esperanza de encontrar refugio.

programme.title: Abandonada
programme.desc: Mary acompaña a su novio al hospital para su cirugía ortopédica. Mientras toma un café en la cafetería, él desaparece. No aparece en la computadora del hospital ni en las cámaras de seguridad.

programme.title: Medidas Desesperadas
programme.desc: Dave y Amy han encontrado la casa perfecta, hasta que descubren un alijo de heroína y terminan encarcelados en ella por matones violentos.

programme.title: Colonia V
programme.desc: En una nueva edad de hielo, un grupo de sobrevivientes lucha por proteger a la humanidad de una amenaza peor que la de la naturaleza.

programme.title: Círculos Siniestros
programme.desc: Alex y Penny están hartos del ajetreo de la ciudad y deciden mudarse al campo para criar a su hijo recién nacido. Pero no se imaginan los horrores que amenazan su relación y su familia.

programme.title: Secretos Malignos
programme.desc: Mientras vuelve a casa tras una cita obstétrica, Esther es brutalmente atacada y desfigurada por un asaltante encapuchado. Este terrible evento parece ser una bendición disfrazada cuando Esther encuentra consuelo en un grupo de apoyo. Su vida de tristeza y soledad se abre a la amistad, la empatía e incluso la aceptación. Sin embargo, la amistad y la empatía pueden ser muy peligrosas cuando involucran a las personas equivocadas.

programme.desc: La historia real de un joven acusado falsamente de violación y condenado a seis años de prisión de máxima seguridad. Debe confiar en sus habilidades de supervivencia y en un vínculo improbable con un recluso infame para demostrar su inocencia y recuperar su libertad.

programme.title: El Ejecutor
programme.desc: Kung Wei es un agente encubierto de la policía china por lo que no puede hablar a su esposa de su trabajo ni asistir a las competiciones de kung fu en las que participa su hijo Johnny. En su nueva misión, Kung se infiltra en una tríada de Hong Kong bajo el mando de Po Kwong, un psicópata criminal. Sin embargo todo se complica cuando se descubre que es policía y raptan a su hijo por lo que Kung Wei y Johnny tendrán que unir su habilidad y destreza en las artes marciales para poder sobrevivir.

programme.title: Lukas
programme.desc: Un portero de discoteca se ve obligado a colaborar con la policía. Esta es su última oportunidad para no perder la custodia de su hija de ocho años. Su misión: infiltrarse en la organización de un peligroso líder de una pandilla holandesa que falsifica dinero.

programme.title: Rescate Sangriento
programme.desc: Un ex mafioso ruso que ahora es escritor de novelas policiales debe enfrentarse a su pasado cuando su familia es blanco de la violencia.

programme.title: El Lobo Solitario
programme.desc: Inspirado en el libro clásico "El agente secreto" de Joseph Conrad. En una Australia futurista, todos los aspectos de la vida cotidiana pueden ser espiados por el gobierno a través de cámaras, intercepciones telefónicas y sistemas de seguridad. En una oscura librería, un grupo de activistas medioambientales se reúne en secreto. La idealista Winnie y su novio Conrad pretenden atacar el G20, un grupo que reúne a los mayores líderes económicos del mundo, pero no saben que están siendo conducidos a una trampa.

programme.desc: Miles es un narcotraficante de alto nivel retirado. El único inconveniente de Miles es su círculo de amigos.

programme.desc: El exitoso abogado neoyorquino Sam Leibowitz viaja al sur en 1933 para defender a nueve jóvenes negros acusados de violar a dos mujeres en un tren de carga de Alabama. programme.title: Asesinos a Sueldo
programme.desc: Inspirada en la historia real de un escándalo en el que reclusos son liberados por un día para trabajar como sicarios de políticos corruptos. Las historias de cuatro hombres que intentan mantener a sus familias se conectan a través de la prisión: dos reclusos que son contratados como asesinos y dos policías que investigan los asesinatos. Mientras se enfrentan, son sus seres queridos los que corren el riesgo de sufrir daños colaterales.

programme.title: Otra Vida
programme.desc: Ren Amari Jessica De Gouw es la inventora de una droga revolucionaria, OtherLife, que expande la sensación temporal del cerebro. Unos pocos segundos de la vida real se convierten en horas y días. Cuando Ren y sus compañeros luchan por lanzar OtherLife, el gobierno lo quiere usar para resolver la superpoblación de las cárceles. Los criminales servirán penas de años en unos pocos minutos. Cuando Ren se resiste, se ve atrapada en una celda en su cabeza. Tendrá que escapar para volver a tomar el control de OtherLife.

programme.title: Rostros en la Oscuridad
programme.desc: Un thriller de terror centrado en una mujer que padece ceguera facial tras sobrevivir al ataque de un asesino en serie. Mientras convive con su condición, en la que sus rasgos faciales cambian cada vez que los pierde de vista, el asesino la acecha.

programme.title: Código Gerónimo: La caza de Bin Laden
programme.desc: Crónica de una de las operaciones militares más importantes, la caza de Osama Bin Laden, conocida con el nombre clave de "Operación Gerónimo". Los Navy Seals, un grupo de fuerzas especiales norteamericano, arriesgaron su vida entrando a ciegas para capturar al hombre más buscado del mundo.

programme.desc: Una familia de la mafia entra en el programa de protección de testigos y es enviada a Normandía, Francia.

programme.desc: Buenos Aires, 1912. Una serie de asesinatos a menores se propaga por la ciudad. Mateo, un nino de 10 anos, esconde un secreto: a veces su mente le conduce a un lugar de la memoria en donde es testigo de los asesinatos. Al descubrirse su secreto muchos creerán que es el asesino. Estela, su madre, con el apoyo del forense de la policía trata de encontrar una explicación a las visiones.

programme.title: Faust, La Venganza Está En La Sangre
programme.desc: Un hombre vende su alma al diablo para obtener superpoderes y vengar la brutal muerte de su novia. Al darse cuenta de que el precio es el alma de su nuevo interés amoroso, se vuelve contra el diablo.

programme.title: El misterio de God´s Pocket
programme.desc: El alocado hijastro de Mickey, Leon, muere en un "accidente" de construcción y Mickey, rápidamente, trata de olvidar esta fatalidad intentando enterrar el cuerpo. Pero cuando un columnista local llega para husmear y descubrir la verdad, las cosas empiezan a ir de mal en peor. Mickey se encuentra atrapado en una lucha con un cuerpo inerte al que no puede enterrar, una esposa que es incapaz de complacer y una deuda que nunca podrá pagar.

programme.desc: Un grupo de jóvenes viaja a la selva de Tarapoto esperando encontrar mucha diversión

programme.title: Ríos de Sangre
programme.desc: Cuando el hijo de un juez afroamericano es asesinado en una parada de rutina que sale mal, el juez Charles Coleman toma la justicia en sus propias manos para asegurarse de que se haga justicia cuando los dos policías salgan libres.

programme.title: Oscuro deseo
programme.desc: Shane entra en una prestigiosa universidad con una beca de deporte y enseguida hace migas con Brandon, su rico compañero de habitación. Brandon le presenta a su familia y Shane se hace ilusiones de que pertenece a ella. Cuando Brandon lo deja de lado porque ha conocido una chica, las cosas se complican y Brandon acaba muerto. Shane se presenta en la casa de Brandon y lo que empieza como una atracción irresistible con la madre de Brandon se acaba convirtiendo en una obsesión hasta el punto que planea matar al marido para quedarse con todo."

programme.title: Faust, La Venganza Está En La Sangre
programme.desc: Un hombre vende su alma al diablo para obtener superpoderes y vengar la brutal muerte de su novia. Al darse cuenta de que el precio es el alma de su nuevo interés amoroso, se vuelve contra el diablo.

programme.title: La Cara del diablo
programme.desc: Un grupo de jóvenes viaja a la selva de Tarapoto esperando encontrar mucha diversión

programme.title: McCanick
programme.desc: A lo largo de un día, un detective de narcóticos persigue a un joven delincuente aparentemente inofensivo que conoce una verdad sobre el pasado del policía.

programme.title: Ríos de Sangre
programme.desc: Cuando el hijo de un juez afroamericano es asesinado en una parada de rutina que sale mal, el juez Charles Coleman toma la justicia en sus propias manos para asegurarse de que se haga justicia cuando los dos policías salgan libres.

programme.title: Oscuro deseo
programme.desc: Shane entra en una prestigiosa universidad con una beca de deporte y enseguida hace migas con Brandon, su rico compañero de habitación. Brandon le presenta a su familia y Shane se hace ilusiones de que pertenece a ella. Cuando Brandon lo deja de lado porque ha conocido una chica, las cosas se complican y Brandon acaba muerto. Shane se presenta en la casa de Brandon y lo que empieza como una atracción irresistible con la madre de Brandon se acaba convirtiendo en una obsesión hasta el punto que planea matar al marido para quedarse con todo."

programme.title: El misterio de God´s Pocket
programme.desc: El alocado hijastro de Mickey, Leon, muere en un "accidente" de construcción y Mickey, rápidamente, trata de olvidar esta fatalidad intentando enterrar el cuerpo. Pero cuando un columnista local llega para husmear y descubrir la verdad, las cosas empiezan a ir de mal en peor. Mickey se encuentra atrapado en una lucha con un cuerpo inerte al que no puede enterrar, una esposa que es incapaz de complacer y una deuda que nunca podrá pagar.

programme.title: El Niño De Barro
programme.desc: Buenos Aires, 1912. Una serie de asesinatos a menores se propaga por la ciudad. Mateo, un nino de 10 anos, esconde un secreto: a veces su mente le conduce a un lugar de la memoria en donde es testigo de los asesinatos. Al descubrirse su secreto muchos creerán que es el asesino. Estela, su madre, con el apoyo del forense de la policía trata de encontrar una explicación a las visiones.

programme.title: Nunca Hables Con Extraños
programme.desc: Sarah Taylor, una psicóloga criminalista, conoce en un supermercado a Tony Ramírez (Banderas), un misterioso e irresistible hombre hispano que la seduce y la enamora. Pero cuando la relación empieza a torcerse, ella decide contratar a un investigador privado para que siga a su amante.

programme.title: El código del asesino
programme.desc: Un detective novato, hijo de un policía caído en desgracia, trabaja para resolver su primer caso importante bajo la atenta mirada de un asesino fantasmal.

programme.title: Historia de una traición
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, Mildred Gillars, conocida como “Axis Sally”, es obligada por los nazis a emitir propaganda para soldados estadounidenses durante la II Guerra Mundial. Tras su relación con Goebbels y su posterior arresto, es juzgada por traición con la ayuda de su abogado defensor.

programme.title: Sed de venganza
programme.desc: Nick Brenner intenta dejar atrás su pasado violento, pero la mafia para la que trabajaba regresa por venganza. Le arrebatan lo que más ama: su esposa. Con ayuda del sheriff local, que además es su suegro, Nick se ve obligado a decidir entre mantener su nueva vida o desatar una sangrienta venganza contra sus enemigos.

programme.title: Comandante General
programme.desc: Un especialista en comando militares es contratado por un multimillonario de Hong Kong para armar un grupo despiadado que tendrá una única misión: eliminar a los criminales más peligrosos y notorios del mundo.

programme.title: Nunca Hables Con Extraños

programme.title: El Amor Mata
programme.desc: Frank es un asesino a sueldo que trabaja para un gran sindicato del crimen de Estiria. Cuando recibe el encargo de secuestrar a una chica llamada Marlene y entregársela al sindicato, todo cambia para él. Se enamora de ella y desobedece las órdenes de sus superiores, que deciden realizar la tarea por su cuenta. Frank tendrá que luchar contra los sicarios del sindicato para salvar a su amada.

programme.title: Posesion Infernal
programme.desc: Bruce Campbell protagoniza esta legendaria película que desató un ejército de cabezas de tornillo y cambió el rostro del terror por siempre. Dirigida por Sam Raimi.

programme.title: Los Otros Dos
programme.desc: Ambientada en Nueva York, la cinta sigue al detective Allen Gamble, un contable forense más interesado en el papeleo que en recorrer las calles, y al detective Terry Hoitz, que ha trabajado con Allen como compañero desde su confrontación con Derek Jeter.

programme.title: La Mancha Voraz
programme.desc: Una malévola forma de vida irrumpe en el pueblo americano de Arborville. Meg, una de las animadoras del instituto, es la primera que ve la gelatina y vive para contarlo gracias a Brian y su moto, que la salvan. Sin problemas de inteligencia ni de conciencia, la gelatina viscosa sólo sabe hacer una cosa, pero la hace muy bien: se come todo lo que se pone por delante: hombres, mujeres y niños.

programme.title: The Spirit
programme.desc: Denny Colt (Gabriel Macht) es un detective enmascarado, un héroe sin superpoderes que protege del crimen a los habitantes de Central City. Colt persigue sin tregua al villano Octopus (Samuel L. Jackson), que asesina sin piedad a cualquiera que le vea la cara. Adaptación de la novela gráfica de Will Eisner.

programme.title: The Dark Tower (2017)
programme.desc: Un mundo moribundo. Un paisaje del viejo oeste, donde el tiempo no corre de forma normal, donde ciudades y regiones enteras desaparecieron sin dejar rastro. El Pistolero Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), último miembro de una orden de caballería denominada los Pistoleros, inicia la búsqueda de un edificio mitológico conocido como La Torre Oscura. Según cuenta la leyenda, esta torre es el centro de convergencia de todos los universos.

programme.title: Ultravioleta
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XXI, surge una subcultura de seres humanos con una mutación genética: están dotados de una asombrosa velocidad, una increíble resistencia y una profunda inteligencia. A medida que hay más personas contagiadas, el temor del gobierno aumenta y a los mutantes se les trata como a marginados, se les somete a pruebas espantosas y se les pone en cuarentena. El gobierno ha tomado la determinación de acabar con ellos, pero una mujer está decidida a impedirlo: la ultrabella y ultraletal Violet. Gracias a sus impresionantes técnicas de artes marciales y a su capacidad camaleónica, Violet se convierte en una guerrera solitaria dedicada a proteger a su nueva raza y a vengarse de los que la crearon.

programme.title: Total Recall (Desafío Total)
programme.desc: Mientras las naciones de Euroamérica y Nueva Shanghái rivalizan por conseguir la supremacía, Doug Quaid es un obrero que sospecha que es espía pero que no sabe para qué lado trabaja.

programme.title: 28 Días Después
programme.desc: Al despertar de un coma en un hospital abandonado de Londres, Jim (Cillian Murphy), un mensajero en bicicleta, sale a las calles desiertas de la ciudad en un estado de confusión. Al unir fuerzas con otro grupo de supervivientes, se entera de que se ha liberado un virus mortal. ¿Existe aún esperanza para la humanidad, o el mortífero virus de la «rabia» ha infectado a todo el planeta?

programme.title: Aún sé lo que hicisteis el último verano
programme.desc: Un año después de ser acosada por Ben Willis, la víctima mortal de un accidente en el que ella estuvo implicada junto a sus amigos, Julie ha dejado su ciudad natal para ir a la Universidad. Una extraña llamada le anuncia que es la ganadora de un fin de semana en una isla paradisiaca, lugar en el que la pesadilla vuelve a repetirse.

programme.title: Criaturas Salvajes
programme.desc: El consejero de un Instituto es seducido por una alumna que posteriormente le acusa de violación. Otra alumna también declarará haber sufrido abusos del mismo hombre. Pero cuando la policía comienza a investigar el caso descubre un plan el que se entremezcla la venganza, lujuria y asesinato.

programme.title: District 9
programme.desc: Del productor Peter Jackson y el director Neill Blomkamp surge un asombrosamente original thriller de ciencia ficción que en el que se envía a un grupo de refugiados alienígenas, varados en la Tierra a un barrio bajo a las afueras de Johannesburgo.

programme.title: Linea Mortal (1990)
programme.desc: Cinco ambiciosos estudiantes de medicina se embarcan en un arriesgado y arrogante experimento: forzar los confines de la vida y tocar la cara de la muerte. Para ayudarle a aventurarse en este reino, el manipulador y ambicioso Nelson Wright (Kiefer Sutherland) ha reclutado a una experta en la muerte (Julia Roberts), a un idealista ex estudiante de medicina (Kevin Bacon), a un ligón (William Baldwin) y a su brillante pero ensimismado documentalista (Oliver Platt). Todos toman turnos para parar sus corazones hasta que los monitores que leen sus signos vitales no indican otra cosa que una línea plana. Momentos después, los otros miembros del equipo intervienen y los reviven. Sin embargo, no tardan en descubrir que no vuelven solos de sus atisbos a la muerte y traen consigo manifestaciones de sus transgresiones pasadas, obligándolos a enfrentarse al pasado en el presente y a aprender duras lecciones sobre la vida y la muerte.

programme.title: Kung Fu Sion
programme.desc: La historia se sitúa durante el caos pre-revolucionario de los años 40 en China. Sing (Stephen Chow) es un delincuente con poca suerte decidido a entrar en el Axe Gang, uno de los clanes mafiosos más importantes de China. Para lograrlo, Sing pretende sacar dinero de los vecinos de un bloque de casas, pero pronto descubre que éstos no son lo que parecen. La banda Axe Gang acude a la zona y una serie de sucesos lleva hasta la confrontación final entre los vecinos y los delincuentes.

programme.title: The Raid 2: Berandal
programme.desc: Poco después de finalizar la sangrienta redada, el inspector Rama se ve obligado a infiltrarse en las filas del sindicato del crimen de Yakarta con el fin de proteger a su familia y descubrir la corrupción en el seno de su propia fuerza policial.

programme.title: Black Hawk Derribado
programme.desc: Las tropas americanas llegaron a Somalia con la esperanza de salvar vidas y no de arrebatarlas. Los soldados, atrapados en la política feudal de Somalia, en la que un clan lleva un milenio enfrentado a otro, se verán condenados a una brutal experiencia cuando la misión da un giro insospechado… resultando en la más grande y singular batalla militar americana desde Vietnam.

programme.title: Bad Boys For Life
programme.desc: Los policías rebeldes originales, Mike Lowrey (Will Smith) y Marcus Burnett (Martin Lawrence), han vuelto. Después de una serie de asesinatos y un atentado contra la vida de Mike, éste convence a un titubeante Marcus para que deje de lado por el momento su jubilación y sean camaradas una última vez. Juntos, se unen a Ammo, la nueva división de tiro de la policia de Miami para derrotar al despiadado jefe del Cartel Aretas.

programme.title: Gothika
programme.desc: Doctora Miranda Grey, una dedicada y exitosa psicóloga criminal, se despierta un día para encontrase que es una paciente en la propia institución mental donde trabaja, sin ningún recuerdo del asesinato que aparentemente ella ha cometido. Pronto descubre que su marido fue brutalmente asesinado 3 días atrás, y las pruebas de sangre... la incriminan a ella.

programme.title: Juegos salvajes 2
programme.desc: La provocativa secuela de Wild Things, un thriller erótico que recaudó treinta millones de dólares. Una joven de 17 años que espera heredar la fortuna de su padrastro se ve envuelta en una relación de amor/odio con su compañera de clase que afirma ser hija ilegítima y heredera de la fortuna. Es un relato de suspense, en el que se mezclan el sexo, el dinero, el engaño y el asesinato.

programme.title: Sé lo que hicisteis el último verano 3
programme.desc: Un grupo de adolecentes mata accidentalmente a un sujeto en la fiesta del 4 de julio. Todo el grupo de amigos decide mantener el secreto hasta la muerte. Están convencidos que ninguno de ellos hablará pero, justo un año después, lo secreto vuelve para vengarse...

programme.title: Mandíbulas 3
programme.desc: Unos cocodrilos asesinos y sus crías aterrorizan a los habitantes de una pequeña comunidad.

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Andrew Neyman (Miles Teller) es un joven baterista de jazz, que solo tiene en mente estar a la altura para cumplir con las exigencias del elitista conservatorio de éxito al que asiste. Marcado por las vivencias de su fracasado padre, un escritor en ciernes, Andrew busca día y noche convertirse en uno de los grandes. Terence Fletcher (J.K. Simmons), instructor conocido por su talento para la enseñanza como por sus terribles métodos, lidera un grupo de jazz en la escuela superior. Fletcher descubre a Andrew y lo transfiere a su banda, hecho que marcará para siempre sus vidas.

programme.title: Sufridos Ciudadanos
programme.desc: Dos hombres en paro descubren que son objetivo de un sicario sin trabajo a quien desarman en un intento de atraco.

programme.title: Krull
programme.desc: En esta aventura fantástica, ambientada en un mundo poblado por criaturas mitológicas y mágicas, el planeta Krull es atacado por un monstruo y un ejército de alienígenas asesinos. Para hacerles frente, dos naciones enemigas deciden unir sus fuerzas por medio del matrimonio del príncipe Colwyn (Kaen Marshall) y la princesa Lyssa (Lysette Anthony); pero el día de la boda, el palacio es asaltado, la princesa secuestrada y Colwyn herido. El príncipe deberá entonces encontrar el Glaive, un arma mágica, para rescatar a la princesa y salvar el planeta.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Un monstruo gigante, originado mediante grandes radiaciones, aterroriza a la isla de Manhattan, sembrando el pánico entre sus habitantes. La criatura destruye todo lo que encuentra a su paso.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) sigue un rastro de pistas a través de Europa con Sienna Brooks (Felicity Jones) para detener un virus que acabaría con la mitad de la población mundial.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) sigue un rastro de pistas a través de Europa con Sienna Brooks (Felicity Jones) para detener un virus que acabaría con la mitad de la población mundial.

programme.title: Rescate Al Amanecer
programme.desc: En 1965, un piloto germano-estadounidense que participaba en una misión de bombardeo de alto secreto fue derribado sobre Laos y llevado a un infernal campo de prisioneros en lo más profundo de la impenetrable selva de Vietnam

programme.title: Proud Mary
programme.desc: La vida de Mary (Taraji P. Henson) , una asesina a suelto de la mafia de Boston, da un vuelco inesperado cuando conoce a un niño que despierta el instinto maternal que creía perdido.

programme.title: Sobreviviendo en Marte
programme.desc: Tras un desastre ecológico, una familia sobrevive en un Marte desolado. Cuando unos bandidos atacan su hogar y matan al padre, solo Ilsa y su hija Remmy logran sobrevivir. Uno de los asaltantes exige quedarse con ellas durante treinta días para demostrar su valía. Madre e hija deberán decidir si pueden confiar en él mientras luchan por sobrevivir en un entorno hostil.

programme.title: Historia de una traición
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, Mildred Gillars, conocida como “Axis Sally”, es obligada por los nazis a emitir propaganda para soldados estadounidenses durante la II Guerra Mundial. Tras su relación con Goebbels y su posterior arresto, es juzgada por traición con la ayuda de su abogado defensor.

programme.title: Feriados
programme.desc: ¿Cuál es el significado de la vida cuando estás en tus 30? Un grupo de amigos y conocidos treintañeros buscan respuestas en su cambiante vida adulta: relación, carrera, familia. Ambientada en fechas importantes, cada episodio marca un cambio en su vida y en su búsqueda de la felicidad; comienzan algo, terminan algo o reconsideran su perspectiva de la vida.

programme.title: La Cornisa
programme.desc: Tras haber tenido un tórrido romance con la mujer de un vecino (Liv Tyler), Gavin (Charlie Hunnam) está en la cornisa de un edificio de gran altura con la intención de saltar al vacío antes de mediodía. Un policía (Terrence Howard) intentará por todos los medios manejar la situación e impedir el suicidio de Gavin. 2011: Festival de Sundance, Nominada al Gran Premio del Jurado

programme.title: Irresistible
programme.desc: Sophie Hartley (Susan Sarandon), una exitosa ilustradora de Melbourne, está convencida de que alguien la acecha. Sospecha que Mara (Emily Blunt), una compañera de trabajo de su marido (Sam Neil), quiere quitarle a sus hijos, a su marido e incluso matarla, pero nadie la cree.

programme.title: Los Hijos de Allen Funt
programme.desc: Entre las paredes de una habitación blanca, cinco personas viven confinadas. A diario, son obligadas a participar en una votación que permitirá al ganador lograr la recompensa prometida de salir al exterior. Uno de ellos tendrá la oportunidad de conseguirlo.

programme.title: Socorro, He Encogido a Mis Padres!
programme.desc: La escuela de Félix vuelve a estar embrujada, sólo que esta vez no es el espíritu de Otto Leonhard, el benévolo fundador de la escuela, sino el de la odiada y fallecida directora Hulda Stingbear. ¿Qué ocurrirá en esta nueva entrega?

programme.title: Un hombre llamado Ove
programme.desc: Un viudo gruñón y solitario encuentra una nueva razón para vivir cuando una familia inmigrante se muda a su vecindario.

programme.title: Hojas de Hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos idénticos (interpretados por Edward Norton) dan un giro cuando el primero, un profesor de filosofía, es confundido por el segundo, un traficante de drogas al que varios clanes del narcotráfico quieren ver muerto.

programme.title: Naufragios
programme.desc: Las historias de cuatro de los naufragios más notables en las costas de Chile durante los siglos XIX y XX, ofrecen una reseña histórica de nuestra identidad como un país remoto y océanico, además de servir como puerto para inmigrantes.

programme.title: Un trabajo embarazoso
programme.desc: Thea (Lindsay Lohan), una joven ejecutiva, finge estar embarazada para evitar que su empresa la despida. Cuando todo el mundo multiplica sus atenciones hacia ella y empieza a recibir cada vez más ayuda, no le queda otra salida que mantener la mentira durante nueve meses… y pensarse cómo puede salir de esta.

programme.desc: Una madre lucha por cuidar a su bebé, mientras el padre se aleja de ellos.

programme.title: La gran enfermedad del amor
programme.desc: Comedia romántica nominada al Oscar a Mejor Guion Original. Kumail y Emily son una pareja que se conoce en un espectáculo de comedia. A pesar de sus diferencias culturales, su relación empieza a avanzar, complicando las vidas de todos por las expectativas de los estrictos padres de Kumail.

programme.title: Nunca Es Tarde Para Enamorarse
programme.desc: Dustin Hoffman da vida a Harvey, un hombre que acaba de quedarse sin trabajo y que viaja a Londres para asistir a la boda de su hija. Para colmo de males, lo han alojado solo en un hotel, mientras el resto de la familia comparte una casa, y su hija quiere que sea su padrastro quien la lleve al altar. Pero conoce a Kate, una peculiar mujer que puede hacer que su viaje a Londres merezca la pena

programme.title: Aborixen
programme.desc: Entre barrancos y naturaleza, fundamentalmente, aprenderemos de un auténtico volcán en erupción, que es Borja Marrero. Un chef con formación académica y gran proyección de futuro. Un pensador y crítico. Un alma viva e hiperactiva, de la que aprenderemos mucho sobre nuestra flora, fauna, así como otros muchos aspectos de la sociedad e historia de Gran Canaria y Canarias en su conjunto.

programme.title: Aquel Septiembre
programme.desc: Septiembre la vida de Antonio se tambalea con el regreso de Carolina, su mejor amiga a la que no ve 6 años.
